data.content_ref: inline:SRC_004 and SRC_003 share a mechanism: both define a forbidden mutation that silently passes because the test suite fails to distinguish a weakened identity comparison (homogenized school ID in SRC_003, ignored endpoint drift in SRC_004) from a correct one. The shared mechanism is a structural equivalence class where the mutation collapses a multi-field identity comparison to a partial key match. It is refuted if the endpoint drift check in SRC_004 operates on a single immutable field rather than a composite identity tuple, making the collapse-to-partial-match mutation inapplicable and severing the shared mechanism.
